description: Prepare an application: tailored CV, cover letter and answers. Builds the materials for one job from the person's own CV (nothing invented): the CV reordered for the job, a cover letter draft with [bracketed] parts only they can fill, and the employer's questions answered from their saved answers where possible. Says how it will be sent and what is still needed. Sends nothing. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.

why_company.description: One real reason this employer appeals to them.
